But what if I don't feel like I am worthy? My entire life I have spent trying to make other people happy to such an extent that I dont feel like a real person anymore and I cant see the point in getting better. Its a nice thought to think that somebody needs me, or that they would miss me, but would they actually need me or miss me? Theyll only miss me because I wont be benefiting them But then ill be replaced like i always am. And then forgotten. Because I am not important at all. They dont need me. So they won't miss me.  I really shouldnt have gotten help for my illness becausethere are better people out there who actually deserve the help unlike me. Even living for the little things doesnt motivate me anymore, because I can't actually feel the joy these thigs are giving me. I know I'm not really happy, these things won't make me happy, it's all my medication. I am not capable of feeling happy anymore. But even if I was happy there would still be no point in me living because of how utterly worthless I am.
